photo_caption: Laurens van Tiggele, left, faces Raoul Popken at the Dutch national team epee championship in Amsterdam’s Oude RAI on Nov. 21, 1965. The winning club was Zaal Abrahamse of The Hague; spectators and another bout fill the space behind the two fencers.
photo_blurb: Look closely and a body cord trails from the nearest fencer.
